title: Report Re K. Oyama, Japanese Couterfeiter Of Debentures

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
C. & S.2, R.L.C. Station,
S. B. D. 2113.
Date March 6, 1931.
2 - 3 - 31.
REPORT
Subject (in full) K. Oyama Japanese counterfeiter of debentures.
Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by W Loucan W.P.I.
Sir,
Enquiries made in connection with the
attached newspaper translation of March 1, 1931 from the
Shanghai Mainichi re the deportation of a Japanese named
Katsuma Oyama show that the local Japanese Consular Police,
acting on the instructions from the Tokyo Metropolitan
Police, arrested him on February 27, 1931 at 123 Nanzing
Road on a charge of forging debentures of a certain Japanese
theatrical company in Tokyo, amounting to approximately
¥1,500.
K. Oyama arrived here from Tokyo in
January 1931 and lived at 123 Nanzing Road, occupied by
his relative named A. Onishi. He was escorted to Tokyo
aboard the S.S. "Shanghai Maru" on March 4, 1931.
* See D.20U2
He had no connection with S. Hashimoto,
who was arrested by the Japanese Consular Police on a charge
of counterfeiting Bank of China notes in Tsingtao.
H. Umemoto
J. D. S.
D. C. (C. & S. Branches)
6. 3. 31.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号
C. & S.2，虹口捕房，
S. B. D. 2113。
日期 1931年3月6日。
2 - 3 - 31。
报告
事由（全称） K. Oyama，日本伪造债券犯。
呈报人 J.D.S. Umemoto。转呈人 W Loucan，西区巡捕房情报股。
敬启者，
就随附的1931年3月1日《上海每日新闻》关于驱逐一名名为Katsuma Oyama的日本人的译文所进行的查询显示，当地日本领事馆警察根据东京警视厅的指示，于1931年2月27日在南京路123号将其逮捕，罪名为伪造东京某日本戏剧公司的债券，金额约为1,500日元。
K. Oyama 于1931年1月从东京抵达此处，居住在南京路123号，该处由其名为 A. Onishi 的亲属占用。他已于1931年3月4日由“上海丸”号轮船押解至东京。
* 见 D.20U2
他与 S. Hashimoto 无任何关联，后者因在青岛伪造中国银行钞票被日本领事馆警察逮捕。
H. Umemoto
J. D. S.
副督察长（刑事侦缉处各分支）
31.3.6.

Form No
G. 20,000

March 1, 1951. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

DEPORTATION OF JAPANESE COUNTERFEITER

The Shanghai Mainichi publishes the following
report:-

It is reported that a Japanese named S. Oyama,
26, who has undergone police examination at the
Japanese Consulate in connection with counterfeiting
banks notes, will be deported to Nagasaki very soon.

ACTIVITIES OF THIEF AND PICKPOCKET

The Shanghai Mainichi publishes the following
report:-

At 4 p.m. February 27, a thief entered a
Japanese house on Dixwell Road and carried off an
overcoat, a hat and a pair of shoes, all of which
are valued at $180.

At 8 p.m. February 27, a certain Japanese visited
the Odeon Theatre and when viewing the picture his
purse containing about $50 in cash was lost.

These cases are being reported to the Police
who are conducting investigation.

表格编号
G. 20,000

1951年3月1日。晨间译文。

杂项

日本伪造货币者被驱逐出境

《上海每日新闻》刊登如下报道：-

据悉，一名26岁的日本人 S. Oyama 因涉及伪造银行钞票案在日本领事馆接受警方讯问后，即将被驱逐至长崎。

窃贼与扒手活动

《上海每日新闻》刊登如下报道：-

2月27日下午4时，一名窃贼闯入狄思威路（Dixwell Road）的一户日本人家中，盗走大衣一件、帽子一顶及鞋子一双，总价值180元。

2月27日晚8时，一名日本人前往奥迪安大戏院（Odeon Theatre）观影，期间装有约50元现金的钱包遗失。

上述案件已报警方，警方正在进行调查。
